notes: Wrote data/tabletop.json and data/snapshots/tabletop/2026-11-20.json from event optimizely-web-script-injection-2026-11 (confirmed; vendor status page plus Unit 42, Sophos, Krebs and BleepingComputer). This is a supplier compromise through third-party website scripts, a different kind of event from the previous exercise (the 2026-11-18 exercise was an exploited Check Point VPN gateway); only one earlier exercise exists. No government guidance was available, so good_looks_like uses Unit 42's recommendations and Report URI's CSP findings. No indicators were copied. The build passes; its 216 hygiene warnings are in existing event records, not in this exercise. status.json was not edited (worker rule). Suggested timestamp: last_tabletop_at 2026-11-20T15:52:00Z; tabletop_note: Optimizely Web Experimentation script injection (16 Nov) — a supplier's trusted JavaScript skimmed cards on 178 organisations' sites; a third-party script risk most organisations with a website face.
